name: metal-engineer
description: Metal engineer role: builds and maintains GPU code on Apple platforms at the 27 releases with Metal 4 and Metal Shading Language 4.1: renderer and compute architecture on tile-based Apple GPUs, shaders, capability checks and device tiers across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro and Apple TV, Swift 6.4 concurrency and C++ interop around the GPU, validation, capture and debugging, performance profiling with counters, and GPU tests in CI. Works alongside Apple's own Xcode and Metal agent skills rather than repeating them.
